baseline_english: And when you cross the Jordan, you shall set up these stones, which I am commanding you today, on Mount Ebal[a], and you shall plaster them with lime.

reader_note.text: The Hebrew base and the selected Rahlfs Greek text read “Mount Ebal”; the Samaritan Pentateuch reads “Mount Gerizim.” The Giessen Greek fragment's published reading also has Gerizim, with a supplied letter and uncertainty in the opening; Old Latin manuscript VL100 reads Garzin (Gerizim). Their textual relationships and which name came first remain uncertain. In 4QDeutf (4Q33), the mountain name is wholly reconstructed within a lacuna, supporting neither reading.
